title: EGP Graphai • Lexical Map Morphology Codes
description: One morphology code system for a language: the positional grammar that says how a code is laid out, and the token map that says what each character means. Robinson's codes for Greek are one such system, and a language may have several.

pos.description: Part-of-speech code this head token maps to. Resolves in the language registry's "pos" category (checked outside this schema).

slots.description: Ordered positions read after the head. Each position is an array of slot names to try, in order, against the code found there.

length.description: Character count that selects this variant's field list.

fields.description: Inflection categories read one character at a time, in order, when the slot has this length.

description.description: Optional explanation of how the slot reads, e.g. why a length tells two readings apart.

prefix.description: Leading token to inflection code, e.g. { "2": "second" }, consumed before the rest of the slot is read.

fields.description: Inflection categories read one character at a time, in order. Mutually exclusive with `variants`.

variants.description: Alternate field lists, selected by the slot's character length. Mutually exclusive with `fields`.

guard.description: Prose condition that must hold for this slot to apply, checked before `fields` or `variants` are read.

whole.description: Whether the whole slot is one code rather than one character per field. Pairs with `category`.

category.description: Inflection category the whole slot resolves to, when `whole` is true.

_id.description: Short identifier for the scheme, e.g. "robinson".

name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. "Robinson's Morphological Analysis Codes".

language.description: _id of the language registry this scheme decodes into, e.g. "greek".

description.description: Prose describing how a code is structured: head, positional slot groups, trailing qualifiers, and how ties are decided.

delimiter.description: Character that separates the head, slot groups, and qualifiers in a raw code, e.g. "-".

heads.description: Every head token this scheme uses, keyed by the token itself, e.g. "V" for a verb.

slots.description: Every slot referenced from `heads`, keyed by slot name.

qualifiers.description: Trailing qualifier token to inflection code, e.g. { "ATT": "attic" }. Qualifiers are optional and may trail any code.

tokens.description: Token maps for each inflection category named in `slots`, e.g. tokens.tense."A" is "aor". Every code produced must resolve in the language registry (checked outside this schema).
